cpu_definition: Sum of user and kernel CPU time over the measured compilation and verification process tree.
memory_definition: Maximum sampled sum of process resident working sets. Shared pages can be counted more than once and peaks between samples may be missed.
scope: Measured compilation process tree. External pinned dependencies were reused. No document builds or unrelated programs are included.
source_applicability: All noncomment source bytes agree with the compiled inputs. Compiled and distributed source identities are recorded separately.
